content:
anya: Quick flag from onboarding: sample app errors are ambiguous. Users see "Request failed: Too many requests" and don't know what to do.

kevin: which SDKs?

anya: JS + Python repros. Example from the client console: { status: 429, error: "Too many requests", message: "Rate limit while calling /v1/generate" } and no Retry-After surfaced.

tariq: suggestion: return a compact structured envelope so SDKs can expose typed exceptions. Fields: type, code, retryable, retry_hint (none|fixed|exponential), retry_after, user_message, docs_url, error_id.

nisha: agree. Also standardize HTTP->type mapping: 401/403 -> AuthError (retryable:false, auth_step: refresh|reauth), 429 -> RateLimitError (retryable:true, retry_hint:fixed), 502/503/504 -> TransientError (retryable:true, retry_hint:exponential).

kevin: parity note: JS has a RateLimitError class; Python and Go need parity. I'll add typed exceptions and helpers like isRetryable() and getRetryAfter().

anya: sampleapp change: show user_message in the toast when present; if auth_step=="refresh" show a re-login CTA. Tariq can you add tests?

tariq: will do. Branch: sampleapp/error-hints.

bot-ci: docs PR opened: docs#2140.

nisha: docs will include mapping table and pseudocode for backoff using retry_hint enum.

kevin: timeline: small beta next week for JS/Python, Go follow-up. Changelog entry: "errors: typed exceptions + machine-readable retry hints"

anya: please ensure Retry-After header is forwarded and error_id included in server logs for trace linking. Also keep user_message free of sensitive data.

kevin: noted. Assigning issues and tagging owners. :thumbsup:
